segments.text:
V. 6.
As ſoon at he ſaid, I am be, they went backward, and fell to the ground—How amazing is it, that they ſhould renew the Aſſault, after ſo ſenſible an Experience both of his Power and Mercy! But probably the Prieſts among them, might perſuade themſelves and their Attendants, that this alſo was done by B••lzebub; and that it was thro' the Providence of GOD, not the Indulgence of Jeſus, that they received no farther Damage.
